Nine Meta feed ads for Jullien Stellar Beauty, 1080×1350.
Each adapts a concept from the reference reel to Jullien's catalogue, claims and voice.

Every testimonial on these boards is a real quote from jullienstellar.com, attributed to the name the site shows. Nothing here is invented — verify each one verbatim before the ads go live.

Board 03 ships with EMPTY before/after slots on purpose.

Drop in real customer photos with a signed release, shot in matching light, or cut the pair and run the board on the three proof points alone. The pair you use has to be a typical result, not your best responder.

Boards 04 and 06 do NOT copy the reference ads' offers.

Jullien's actual policy is device replacement on malfunction, ampoules final sale — board 04 states that. The reference's "40% OFF" becomes the real 15% on the Essentials Set ($424.15 from $499). If either number moves, both boards move with it.

Three claims on the new boards need sign-off before spend:

07 — "Our best-selling" is a first-party claim about Jullien's own ranking. Confirm the Airbrush + Core Complex duo actually is the top seller, or swap the line.

08 — the fingertip framing is comparative. It rests on Jullien's own "touchless by design" and "no waste" positioning; keep it there and do not escalate it into a hygiene or infection claim.

09 — the week-by-week milestones inherit the same substantiation the one-week / four-week claim needs. The seal says 8% and Engineered in Seoul, both factual. It deliberately does NOT say "clinically studied" — do not add that without a study.
